svg.title: FORME / Atelier — desktop composition
svg.desc: Editable layout study. Furniture images are original Blender CGI. Text, surfaces and controls remain separate SVG elements. Live Liquid code is authoritative for responsive behaviour.
svg.text: Thoughtful pieces. Made for the everyday.
Pieces that settle into your life, beautifully.
Materials with character. Objects that feel at home.
A few things to come home to.
Three sizes. Three upholstery families. Four natural tones.
